evidence_items.explanation: This supports the narrower proposition that comprehensive federal AI regulation was absent. Its date and federal scope prevent it from settling the claim about all applicable US law on August 23, 2024.

Colorado had enacted AI legislation before the post. The report describes discrimination safeguards beginning in 2026, rather than an external body controlling frontier model releases, so this does not directly contradict the contextual reading.
